integrity: Closed-form identities are analytically proved and independently checked against exhaustive rational finite models. Finite enumeration is not used to establish infinite statements.
scientific_limitations: Uniform attachment started from the deterministic edge, undirected degree-one leaves, shared-prefix coupling. Joint CLT is an asymptotic distributional statement, not a finite-sample error bound. Historical literature could implicitly cover derived formulas; independent scientific priority and full independent proof audit remain unperformed.
title: Cubic memory of shared ancestry in leaf counts of correlated uniform-attachment trees
